fields.name: Ash Fever
fields.description: A smoky fever causes the {{ status_effect:feverish.name }} status effect and sensitivity to open flame.

fields.name: Marsh Lung
fields.description: A damp cough and shortness of breath associated with stagnant wetlands.

fields.name: Red Flux
fields.description: A draining intestinal illness marked by cramps, thirst, and rapid weakness.

fields.name: Glass Cough
fields.description: A painful dry cough that produces tiny translucent crystals of uncertain origin.

fields.name: Sleeping Sickness
fields.description: Increasing bouts of sleep interrupt ordinary activity and become difficult to resist.

fields.name: Frost Rot
fields.description: Numb, discolored tissue spreads after prolonged cold or supernatural exposure.

fields.name: Spore Fever
fields.description: An invasive fungus causes vivid dreams and the {{ status_effect:confused.name }} status effect.

fields.name: Black Vein
fields.description: Darkened veins slowly spread from an infected wound as strength fades.

fields.name: Oathbrand
fields.description: A visible mark reacts whenever the bearer approaches breaking a sworn promise.

fields.name: Mirror Curse
fields.description: Reflections occasionally act out intentions the bearer has tried to conceal.

fields.name: Hunger Mark
fields.description: Ordinary meals no longer bring lasting satisfaction, regardless of abundance.

fields.name: Stone Sleep
fields.description: Each deep sleep leaves part of the body briefly cold, heavy, and stone-like.

fields.name: Whispering Mark
fields.description: A hidden mark repeats fragments of nearby secrets when the surroundings are quiet.

fields.name: Nightmare Chain
fields.description: Recurring dreams connect the bearer to a place, object, or unknown sleeper.

fields.name: Withering Touch
fields.description: Delicate plants and perishable goods deteriorate unusually quickly in the bearer’s hands.

fields.name: Borrowed Shadow
fields.description: The bearer’s shadow sometimes follows movements belonging to someone else.
